topic: 数据比较与图表描述入门
grammarFocus: 比较结构；百分比与数量表达；there was / were；趋势动词。
title: Comparing Two School Clubs: A Simple Data Report
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。文章和问题均为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思试题。请根据文章内容选择或填写答案。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。
passage:
Last year, our school had two popular clubs: the Chess Club and the Drama Club. At the end of the year, the school office wrote a short report about them. The report compared the two clubs. It used simple numbers and charts. Here is what the report said.

A. Membership numbers
In September, the Chess Club had 40 members. The Drama Club had 60 members. So the Drama Club was bigger at the start. But in January, the Chess Club had 55 members. The Drama Club had 50 members. The Chess Club grew by 15 members. The Drama Club lost 10 members. By June, the Chess Club had 70 members, and the Drama Club had 45 members. The Chess Club became the larger club. The report showed these numbers in a table. The table had three columns: month, Chess Club members, and Drama Club members. The table made it easy to see the changes.

B. Weekly activities
Both clubs met once a week. The Chess Club met on Tuesdays. The Drama Club met on Thursdays. The Chess Club usually played games for 90 minutes. The Drama Club practiced plays for 120 minutes. So the Drama Club meetings were longer. There were 30 Chess Club meetings and 28 Drama Club meetings during the year. The Chess Club had two more meetings than the Drama Club. The report also noted that the Chess Club sometimes had special workshops on weekends. There were 5 workshops last year. The Drama Club had 3 weekend rehearsals. These extra activities were not in the weekly meeting count.

C. Costs and fees
Each club asked for a small fee. The Chess Club fee was $10 per year. The Drama Club fee was $15 per year. The Drama Club also needed money for costumes. It spent $200 on costumes last year. The Chess Club spent $50 on new chess sets. So the Drama Club cost more in total. The report calculated the total cost per member. For the Chess Club, the total cost was $60 (fees plus equipment). For the Drama Club, the total cost was $215 (fees plus costumes). The report showed a pie chart to compare these costs. The pie chart had two parts: one for the Chess Club and one for the Drama Club. The Drama Club part was much bigger.

D. Student satisfaction
At the end of the year, 80% of Chess Club members said they were happy. Only 60% of Drama Club members said they were happy. The report showed this in a bar chart. The Chess Club had a higher satisfaction rate. But the Drama Club had more fun activities, according to some students. The report also asked about the reasons. 70% of Chess Club members said they liked the quiet atmosphere. 50% of Drama Club members said they liked the creative activities. These percentages were shown in a second bar chart.

E. Trends over three years
This was the third year of the report. Three years ago, the Chess Club had only 20 members. The Drama Club had 80 members. Since then, the Chess Club membership increased every year. The Drama Club membership decreased slowly. The report showed a line graph. The line for the Chess Club went up. The line for the Drama Club went down. The report also noted that the total number of students in both clubs changed. Three years ago, there were 100 members in total. Last year, there were 115 members in total. So the overall interest in clubs increased.

F. Conclusion
The report said: “The Chess Club is now the bigger club. It also has happier members. But the Drama Club still has an important place in our school. Both clubs are valuable.” The school plans to write a similar report next year. The report will help the school decide how to support both clubs.

questions.prompt: In September, how many members did the Chess Club have?
questions.explanation: 原文A部分第一句明确说“In September, the Chess Club had 40 members.”，所以答案是40。
questions.evidence: In September, the Chess Club had 40 members.

questions.prompt: Which club had more members in January?
questions.explanation: 原文说“in January, the Chess Club had 55 members. The Drama Club had 50 members.”，55大于50，所以一月时Chess Club人数更多。
questions.evidence: But in January, the Chess Club had 55 members. The Drama Club had 50 members.

questions.prompt: How long did the Drama Club usually meet each week?
questions.explanation: 原文B部分说“The Drama Club practiced plays for 120 minutes.”，所以Drama Club每周活动通常120分钟。
questions.evidence: The Drama Club practiced plays for 120 minutes.

questions.prompt: How much did the Drama Club spend on costumes last year? (Write a number and the dollar sign, e.g. $50)
questions.explanation: 原文C部分说“It spent $200 on costumes last year.”，所以答案是$200。
questions.evidence: It spent $200 on costumes last year.

questions.prompt: What percentage of Chess Club members said they were happy?
questions.explanation: 原文D部分说“80% of Chess Club members said they were happy.”，所以答案是80%。
questions.evidence: At the end of the year, 80% of Chess Club members said they were happy.

questions.prompt: Three years ago, which club had more members?
questions.explanation: 原文E部分说“Three years ago, the Chess Club had only 20 members. The Drama Club had 80 members.”，80大于20，所以三年前Drama Club人数更多。
questions.evidence: Three years ago, the Chess Club had only 20 members. The Drama Club had 80 members.

questions.prompt: What does the line graph in the report show about the Chess Club membership?
questions.explanation: 原文E部分说“The line for the Chess Club went up.”，所以折线图显示Chess Club会员人数上升。
questions.evidence: The line for the Chess Club went up.

questions.prompt: According to the report, the Drama Club meetings were longer than the Chess Club meetings.
questions.explanation: 原文B部分说Chess Club活动90分钟，Drama Club活动120分钟，所以Drama Club会议更长，该说法正确。
questions.evidence: The Chess Club usually played games for 90 minutes. The Drama Club practiced plays for 120 minutes.

questions.prompt: The Chess Club fee was more expensive than the Drama Club fee.
questions.explanation: 原文C部分说Chess Club费用是$10，Drama Club费用是$15，所以Chess Club费用更便宜，该说法错误。
questions.evidence: The Chess Club fee was $10 per year. The Drama Club fee was $15 per year.

questions.explanation: 原文只提到学校计划明年写类似的报告，没有说Drama Club会关闭。因此该信息未给出。
questions.evidence: The school plans to write a similar report next year.

grammar.title: 比较结构；百分比与数量表达；there was / were；趋势动词
grammar.explanation: 比较结构用来比较两个事物，常用“more + 形容词 + than”或“形容词 + -er + than”。百分比用“数字 + %”表示，如80%。数量表达可用“数字 + 名词”，如40 members。there was / were 表示“过去有”，单数用was，复数用were。趋势动词描述变化方向，如increase（上升）、decrease（下降）、grow（增长）、go up（上升）、go down（下降）。
grammar.example: The Chess Club grew by 15 members. The Drama Club lost 10 members.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence to compare two clubs.
options: The Chess Club is more popular than the Drama Club.
The Chess Club is popular than the Drama Club.
The Chess Club is most popular than the Drama Club.
The Chess Club popular than the Drama Club.
answers: The Chess Club is more popular than the Drama Club.
questions.explanation: 比较两个事物时用“more + 形容词 + than”结构，所以第一句正确。
questions.evidence: The Chess Club is more popular than the Drama Club.

questions.prompt: There ___ 30 Chess Club meetings last year.
questions.explanation: 主语30 Chess Club meetings是复数，且时间是last year（过去），所以用there were。
questions.evidence: There were 30 Chess Club meetings last year.

questions.prompt: The Drama Club membership ___ slowly last year.
questions.explanation: 描述去年（过去）的趋势，动词用过去式decreased。
questions.evidence: The Drama Club membership decreased slowly.

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses a percentage?
options: 80% of Chess Club members said they were happy.
80% Chess Club members said they were happy.
80 percent of Chess Club members said they were happy.
80% of Chess Club member said they were happy.
answers: 80% of Chess Club members said they were happy.
questions.explanation: 百分比后接“of + 名词复数”表示“……中的百分之……”。选项B缺少of；选项C虽然语法上也可接受，但原文使用的是百分号形式，且题目要求选择与原文一致的表达；选项D名词member应为复数members。因此只有选项A完全正确。
questions.evidence: 80% of Chess Club members said they were happy.
